name: BulletFormat
example:
With ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Shapes(2)

    With .TextFrame.TextRange.ParagraphFormat.Bullet

        .Visible = True

        .RelativeSize = 1.25

        .Character = 169

        With .Font

            .Color.RGB = RGB(255, 255, 0)

            .Name = "Symbol"

        End With

    End With

End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Character
properties.description: Returns or sets the Unicode character value that is used for bullets in the specified text. Read/write.

properties.name: RelativeSize
properties.description: Returns or sets the bullet size relative to the size of the first text character in the paragraph. Read/write.

properties.name: UseTextColor
properties.description: Determines whether the specified bullets are set to the color of the first text character in the paragraph. Read/write.

properties.name: UseTextFont
properties.description: Determines whether the specified bullets are set to the font of the first text character in the paragraph. Read/write.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns a Font object that represents character formatting. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Represents the type of bullet. Read/write.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns or sets the bullet style. Read/write.

properties.name: StartValue
properties.description: Returns or sets the beginning value of a bulleted list when the Type property of the BulletFormat object is set to ppBulletNumbered. Read/write.

properties.name: Number
properties.description: Returns the bullet number of a paragraph when the Type property of the BulletFormat object is set to ppBulletNumbered. Read-only.

methods.name: Picture
methods.description: Sets the graphics file to be used for bullets in a bulleted list when the Type property of the BulletFormat object is set to ppBulletPicture.
